headline: Kingery's pinch-hit homer walks off Braves in 11th
recap: Scott Kingery, pinch-hitting with two outs in the bottom of the 11th, lined a three-run homer off Mark Melancon to give the Phillies a 7-4 win over the Atlanta Braves. J.T. Realmuto, who started the inning on second base under that season's extra-innings runner rule, advanced to third on a Jean Segura sacrifice bunt, and Didi Gregorius was intentionally walked before Neil Walker struck out to bring up Kingery.

Zack Wheeler worked 5.2 innings for the Phillies, allowing seven hits but only one earned run. Braves starter Robbie Erlin lasted four innings and was charged with four earned runs, including two home runs.

Andrew McCutchen and Segura hit two-run homers in the third and fourth innings to put the Phillies up 4-1. Atlanta cut it to 4-2 on an unearned run in the sixth after a throwing error by Gregorius, then tied it 4-4 in the seventh when Ender Inciarte and Austin Riley hit solo homers off reliever Adam Morgan. Blake Parker pitched a scoreless top of the 11th to pick up the win.
